author: BassRockinFreak
body: Won’t help your survivability but a warhorse pet can give them def double down if you’re just going for a big single hitter. Any of the  omnistrike/s skills will give them single debuffs as well. Stack the two def downs and it’s basically pure damage from there. (I’d recommend getting PD and making sure you’re on track for the T9 class though.)

author: ErTaiGa
body:
You can also debuff him by using omnistrike/s and hoping or use exploit for the def down, so you'll deal more damage. I'm always debuffing raids, if possible, so I can deal more damage faster and so health draining abilities like drain or osmostrike/s heal more if shit hits the fan.

Edit: you can also decrease their damage by either using threaten/mute or hoping for the debuffs to proc by using omnistrike/s
